text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash is bewildered, having lost 
her guiding principle. To help her look 
forward again, we decided to have her 
speak with Tokai Teio, an Umamusume who 
knows what it is to face setbacks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"What would the person I look up to do?" 
Tokai Teio smiles, saying that thinking 
this way made her decide to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of the people she admired—her 
parents— Eishin Flash was able to view the 
schedule adjustments in a positive light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the Japan Cup, where 
challenges equal to or greater than the 
Kikuka Sho surely awaited, it was time to 
adjust course. Her next goal had finally 
been set.
